summary: This Form 6-K filed by Central North Airport Group (OMA) for May 2026 reports a routine monthly operational update: terminal passenger traffic at its 13 airports decreased 4.4% in April 2026 versus April 2025, with domestic traffic down 3.4% and international traffic down 9.8%. The filing includes contact information, a description of the company, and certification by the CFO. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation event. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing ordinary business metrics.
